_about: Names and descriptions for the listening page (beads/test/listen.py). 'folders' says which version of the firmware a folder holds; 'renders' says what each harness render is. Keys are repo-relative folder paths and WAV file names. A folder without an entry shows its path.

audio_samples.label: Source
audio_samples.description: The input fed to every render, unprocessed.

renders/stock.label: Stock
renders/stock.description: Upstream firmware, before any Soft Beads change. The reference.

renders/stock-shape.label: Stock · Shape positions
renders/stock-shape.description: Upstream firmware on the cloud patch at the same five knob positions as ticket 09, plus its bell (Shape 0.66, beads_cloud). Knob positions mean different windows here: stock runs square, decay, bell, reverse.

renders/09-shape-sweep.label: 09 · Shape morph
renders/09-shape-sweep.description: Shape remapped to one continuous morph: decay, square, Tukey, Hann, Gaussian. Reverse is gone. Includes every earlier change. beads_cloud is at Hann.

renders/10-diffuser.label: 10 · Diffuser
renders/10-diffuser.description: Clouds' allpass diffuser on the wet bus, faded in with an equal-power blend from Hann (off) to fully clockwise (full). Includes every earlier change. Below Hann these are byte-identical to 09.

renders/10-diffuser/sweep/control.label: 10 sweep · kap 0.625 (current)
renders/10-diffuser/sweep/control.description: Clouds' coefficient, lines fixed. The version you heard as metallic.

renders/10-diffuser/sweep/kap050.label: 10 sweep · kap 0.5
renders/10-diffuser/sweep/kap050.description: Lower allpass coefficient, lines fixed. Shorter ring, still dense.

renders/10-diffuser/sweep/kap040.label: 10 sweep · kap 0.4
renders/10-diffuser/sweep/kap040.description: Lower again. Ring is about half as long as 0.625, and transients start to show through.

renders/10-diffuser/sweep/kap030.label: 10 sweep · kap 0.3
renders/10-diffuser/sweep/kap030.description: Lowest. Shortest ring, least smear; grain edges mostly survive.

renders/10-diffuser/sweep/smear.label: 10 sweep · kap 0.625, modulated
renders/10-diffuser/sweep/smear.description: Clouds' coefficient, with each channel's first line slowly modulated (0.5 and 0.3 Hz), as in the reverb. The delays no longer sit still.

renders/10-diffuser/sweep/smear_kap050.label: 10 sweep · kap 0.5, modulated
renders/10-diffuser/sweep/smear_kap050.description: Lower coefficient plus the same slow modulation.

renders/sources.label: Sources · dry
renders/sources.description: Extra dry sources: picked guitar (Sublustris clip 09, CC0 Emily guitar), sustained poly synth chords (clip 08, synthesised), drum groove with stabs (clip 03, CC0 drums). 30 s, looped where shorter.

renders/10-diffuser/sources/kettel.label: 10 variants · Test source
renders/10-diffuser/sources/kettel.description: The diffuser variants at Shape fully clockwise on the usual synthetic test source.

renders/10-diffuser/sources/guitar.label: 10 variants · Guitar
renders/10-diffuser/sources/guitar.description: The diffuser variants at Shape fully clockwise on the picked guitar.

renders/10-diffuser/sources/synth.label: 10 variants · Synth chords
renders/10-diffuser/sources/synth.description: The diffuser variants at Shape fully clockwise on sustained poly synth chords. Ring should show most here.

renders/10-diffuser/sources/groove.label: 10 variants · Drum groove
renders/10-diffuser/sources/groove.description: The diffuser variants at Shape fully clockwise on a drum groove with stabs.

renders/04-wet-gain.label: 04 · Wet gain 0.94
renders/04-wet-gain.description: Wet gain lowered from 1.5 to 0.94, so a dense cloud at 12 o'clock sits within 1 dB of the dry.

renders/05-envelope-sum.label: 05 · Envelope-sum normalisation
renders/05-envelope-sum.description: The wet bus is scaled by 1/max(Σenv, 1) instead of 1/√n per grain at birth. Includes ticket 04.

renders/05-envelope-sum/pre.label: 05 sweep · Before (per-grain 1/√n)
renders/05-envelope-sum/pre.description: Stock normalisation, with ticket 04's gain. The baseline for the exponent sweep.

renders/05-envelope-sum/q1.label: 05 sweep · Linear, q = 1 (chosen)
renders/05-envelope-sum/q1.description: Bus scaled by 1/max(Σenv, 1). Flat level across Density 0.6–0.9; what shipped.

renders/05-envelope-sum/q2.label: 05 sweep · Square root, q = 2
renders/05-envelope-sum/q2.description: Bus scaled by 1/max(√Σenv², 1), as ADR 0004 first named. Gets louder as Density rises, and clips.

renders/06-wet-saturator.label: 06 · Wet saturator at −6 dBFS
renders/06-wet-saturator.description: Wet bus untouched below −6 dBFS, then a tanh curve toward 0 dBFS. Includes 04 and 05.

renders/06-wet-saturator/sweep/off.label: 06 sweep · Saturator off
renders/06-wet-saturator/sweep/off.description: Ticket 05's code. Overs go straight to the stock limiter, and the hot render clips 7 samples.

renders/06-wet-saturator/sweep/m06.label: 06 sweep · Knee at −6 dBFS (chosen)
renders/06-wet-saturator/sweep/m06.description: Touches about 0.04% of samples in the hot render: a safety net for overs, no colour in normal playing.

renders/06-wet-saturator/sweep/m09.label: 06 sweep · Knee at −9 dBFS
renders/06-wet-saturator/sweep/m09.description: Touches about 0.3% of samples in the hot render. Peaks of dense clouds start to round off.

renders/06-wet-saturator/sweep/m12.label: 06 sweep · Knee at −12 dBFS
renders/06-wet-saturator/sweep/m12.description: Touches about 1.6% of samples in the hot render. The most audible softening of the four.

renders/07-min-attack.label: 07 · Minimum attack 3 ms
renders/07-min-attack.description: Grain attack floor raised from 0.5 ms to 3 ms. Includes 04, 05 and 06.

renders/07-min-attack/sweep/a0p5.label: 07 sweep · 0.5 ms floor (before)
renders/07-min-attack/sweep/a0p5.description: Ticket 06's code, unchanged. Granular player render: 412 clicks.

renders/07-min-attack/sweep/a1.label: 07 sweep · 1 ms floor
renders/07-min-attack/sweep/a1.description: Minimum grain attack doubled. Granular player render: 393 clicks, about level with stock's 395.

renders/07-min-attack/sweep/a3.label: 07 sweep · 3 ms floor (chosen)
renders/07-min-attack/sweep/a3.description: Granular player render: 359 clicks, 9% under stock.

renders/07-min-attack/sweep/a5.label: 07 sweep · 5 ms floor
renders/07-min-attack/sweep/a5.description: The softest tested. Granular player render: 325 clicks, 18% under stock. Listen for transients losing their edge.

renders/08-voice-stealing-fade.label: 08 · Current code
renders/08-voice-stealing-fade.description: Includes 04 to 07. Ticket 08 kept the 5 ms fade, so the DSP is unchanged from 07.

renders/08-voice-stealing-fade/sweep/f5.label: 08 sweep · 5 ms fade (kept)
renders/08-voice-stealing-fade/sweep/f5.description: Voice-stealing fade unchanged, bit-identical to ticket 07 on the shared renders.

renders/08-voice-stealing-fade/sweep/f10.label: 08 sweep · 10 ms fade
renders/08-voice-stealing-fade/sweep/f10.description: Fade doubled. Click counts unchanged. The difference from 5 ms is about 40 dB below the signal on the wet render.

renders/08-voice-stealing-fade/sweep/f15.label: 08 sweep · 15 ms fade
renders/08-voice-stealing-fade/sweep/f15.description: Click counts unchanged. The difference from 5 ms is about 36 dB below the signal on the wet render.

renders/08-voice-stealing-fade/sweep/f20.label: 08 sweep · 20 ms fade
renders/08-voice-stealing-fade/sweep/f20.description: The longest the scheduler ordering allows here. Click counts unchanged. The difference from 5 ms is about 34 dB below the signal on the wet render.

renders/16-wet-level.label: 16 · Wet level with random Time
renders/16-wet-level.description: Bus gain blends from 1/sum towards 1/sqrt(sum) when Time or Pitch is randomised. Max blend 0.75, sensitivity 100. Renders with fixed Time are bit-identical to 08.

renders/16-wet-level/sweep/m0.label: 16 sweep · blend 0 (before)
renders/16-wet-level/sweep/m0.description: Ticket 08's maths. Cloud 4 dB under the dry.

renders/16-wet-level/sweep/m100.label: 16 sweep · blend 1.0
renders/16-wet-level/sweep/m100.description: Full 1/sqrt(sum). Cloud 1.1 dB over the dry.

renders/16-wet-level/sweep-scale/s20.label: 16 sensitivity · 20
renders/16-wet-level/sweep-scale/s20.description: Max blend 0.75. Level dips about 3 dB at very small Time spreads.

renders/16-wet-level/sweep-scale/s50.label: 16 sensitivity · 50
renders/16-wet-level/sweep-scale/s50.description: Max blend 0.75. Level dips about 1.5 dB at Time spread 0.01.

renders/16-wet-level/sweep-scale/s100.label: 16 sensitivity · 100 (chosen)
renders/16-wet-level/sweep-scale/s100.description: Max blend 0.75. Level is flat from Time spread 0.01 up.

renders/check.label: Latest check run
renders/check.description: Whatever the working tree rendered on the last `measure.py --check`. Not a fixed version.

renders.kettel.wav: The test source: 48 kHz stereo, as fed to the harness.
renders.beads_processor.wav: The full module: Density 0.7, mix 0.9, a little reverb, 30 s. Closest to playing it.
renders.beads_granular_player.wav: The grain engine alone, before mix and reverb.
renders.beads_granular_processor.wav: The granular processor alone, before the dry/wet mix and reverb.
renders.beads_wetdry_wet.wav: Fully wet, Density 0.9, no reverb or feedback. Nothing is randomised, so it sounds close to the source delayed by about 0.4 s. There's no dry in it. For grain character, use beads_cloud.wav.
renders.beads_wetdry_dry.wav: Fully dry, same patch. What the wet is level-matched against.
renders.beads_drive_hot.wav: Fully wet, dense cloud, source 6 dB hotter than normal. Drives peaks into the saturator; listen to transients and the loudest swells.
renders.beads_drive_quiet.wav: Fully wet, dense cloud, source 12 dB down. Below the saturator; should sound identical across versions.
renders.beads_steal_s090.wav: Fully wet, Size 0.9, Density 0.9. About 38 grains want to overlap in a 32-grain pool, so voice stealing runs.
renders.beads_steal_s098.wav: Fully wet, Size 0.98, Density 0.9, the longest grains before delay mode. About 83 grains want to overlap in a 32-grain pool, so voice stealing runs hard.
renders.beads_cloud.wav: Fully wet, a properly granular cloud: Density 0.9, Size 0.75, Shape at the bell, Time spread over about a second per grain, Pitch fixed. No reverb or feedback.
renders.beads_cloud_hot.wav: The granular cloud with the source 6 dB hotter, driving the saturator.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_d060.wav: Granular cloud at Density 0.6, Time spread 0.25, 15 s.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_d070.wav: Granular cloud at Density 0.7, Time spread 0.25, 15 s.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_d080.wav: Granular cloud at Density 0.8, Time spread 0.25, 15 s.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_d090.wav: Granular cloud at Density 0.9, Time spread 0.25, 15 s.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_d100.wav: Granular cloud at Density 1.0, Time spread 0.25, 15 s.
renders.beads_cloudlevel_t000.wav: Density 0.9 with Time spread 0: grains in phase, 15 s.
renders.beads_density_000.wav: Fully wet, Density 0.0 (regular, audio-rate end), 15 s.
renders.beads_density_100.wav: Fully wet, Density 1.0 (random, audio-rate end), 15 s.
renders.beads_shape_000.wav: Cloud patch, Shape fully anticlockwise. 09: decay. Stock: square.
renders.beads_shape_025.wav: Cloud patch, Shape 9 o'clock. 09: square. Stock: on the way to decay.
renders.beads_shape_050.wav: Cloud patch, Shape 12 o'clock. 09: Tukey. Stock: just past decay.
renders.beads_shape_075.wav: Cloud patch, Shape 3 o'clock. 09: Hann. Stock: just past the bell.
renders.guitar.wav: Picked guitar chords in D, dry.
renders.nodiffuser.wav: Gaussian at fully clockwise with no diffuser, the reference.
renders.control.wav: Diffuser at kap 0.625, fixed lines (what was heard as metallic).
renders.smear.wav: Diffuser at kap 0.625, first line of each channel slowly modulated.
renders.smear_kap050.wav: Diffuser at kap 0.5, first line of each channel slowly modulated.
renders.beads_shape_088.wav: Cloud patch, Shape halfway from 3 o'clock to fully clockwise. 10: half Hann-to-Gaussian, half diffuser.
renders.beads_shape_100.wav: Cloud patch, Shape fully clockwise. 09: Gaussian. 10: Gaussian with the full diffuser. Stock: reverse.
